meta.title: Task completion notice
meta.description: Plays a sound and shows a Windows desktop notification when a turn finishes: the title carries the workspace folder, the body the last reply and the elapsed time. Subagent turns stay silent by default, and the notification can open as a corner window instead of a toast. Sound, style, wording, minimum turn duration and the notification sender are configurable. Windows 10/11 only; nothing is sent anywhere.
